command:
set -eu
echo USB_INTERFACE_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
p=/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1
if test -d "$p"; then
 for n in idVendor idProduct product manufacturer bNumConfigurations bNumInterfaces; do
  if test -r "$p/$n"; then echo ATTR=$n; cat "$p/$n"; fi
 done
 if test -r "$p/descriptors"; then echo CACHED_DESCRIPTORS; od -An -v -tx1 "$p/descriptors"; fi
 for i in /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:*; do
  if test -d "$i"; then
   echo INTERFACE=$i
   for n in bInterfaceNumber bAlternateSetting bInterfaceClass bInterfaceSubClass bInterfaceProtocol interface modalias; do
    if test -r "$i/$n"; then echo ATTR=$n; cat "$i/$n"; fi
   done
   if test -L "$i/driver"; then echo DRIVER; readlink -f "$i/driver"; else echo DRIVER_LINK_ABSENT; fi
   for t in "$i"/tty* "$i"/tty/tty* "$i"/*/tty*; do
    if test -e "$t"; then echo TTY_ENTRY; ls -ld "$t"; fi
   done
  fi
 done
else echo USB_PARENT_ABSENT; fi
for p in /dev/ttyACM* /dev/ttyUSB*; do
 if test -e "$p"; then echo DEVICE_NODE_METADATA; ls -ld "$p"; fi
done
echo USB_INTERFACE_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: cached USB/sysfs and device-node metadata only; no device open, USB request, or interface binding
